name: io.github.Cratis/chronicle-mcp
title: Cratis Chronicle
description: Explore and operate Cratis Chronicle event stores, and design event-sourcing artifacts with AI.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open for MCP stdio communication.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the server exits.

environmentVariables.name: Cratis__Chronicle__Mcp__ConnectionString
environmentVariables.description: Chronicle endpoint reachable from the container; host.docker.internal reaches the host on macOS/Windows.

environmentVariables.name: Cratis__Chronicle__Mcp__ClientId
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID; set together with ClientSecret to override development credentials.

environmentVariables.name: Cratis__Chronicle__Mcp__ClientSecret
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret; set together with ClientId to override development credentials.

environmentVariables.name: Cratis__Chronicle__Mcp__ApiKey
environmentVariables.description: API key for authentication, as an alternative to client credentials.

environmentVariables.name: Cratis__Chronicle__Mcp__EventStore
environmentVariables.description: Default event store used by tools when none is specified.

environmentVariables.name: Cratis__Chronicle__Mcp__Namespace
environmentVariables.description: Default namespace used by tools when none is specified.
